## Latest completed source intake — 2026-10-16

Published content: `2c6a16f1b37412c822c8b63db5ed35416bd385ff` (task content `508f732e01d4ed84b02896e2a0e86a19307d5d43`; preserves concurrent same-branch thermal-CX R1–R6 changes).

- SOURCE012: 409 private captured files, 7,396,570 bytes; scoped partial-capture publication PASS, complete-input/reference readiness HOLD. Both collector failures and the single approved repair remain recorded. Two exact static dependencies were not captured under the bounded resource limit. No native/reference solve was run.
- REC #99 at `a5e92bd17f1c0a1fd331ee203405d3971c444efb`: actual source-qualified q=0 z=20 candidate now available, xe/H=0.00021034919293635483 and Tm=9.306042400382015 K. Helium normalization, cosmology/census/EOS/clock compatibility remain explicit; REI adoption false and temporal refinement NOT_RUN.
- REI #151 at `edead5026fdcc4217a9caec5106f7839c6aec5a5`: synthetic local resume implementation only; physical native continuation and 128-column result remain NOT_RUN.
- Same-branch thermal-CX additions contain scoped theory/contract review. The recorded oracle attempt did not execute because `/usr/bin/time` was missing. No new thermal-CX numerical result or cosmological isotope history is claimed.

Reports: [SOURCE012](research/bass_source012_source_age_reference_20261016/intake_001/REPORT_KO.md), [external refresh005](research/external_update_intake_20261016_001/refresh_005/REPORT_KO.md), [aggregate return](research/bass_source012_source_age_reference_20261016/intake_001/delivery/RETURN_CONTRACT.json).

Checkpoint: PAUSED_RESUMABLE; GOAL_DONE=false. Original native cutoff 2026-10-16T02:50:17.774070Z was not reset. Full signed-Bianchi convergence/isotope-native activation remain incomplete. No green-CI claim; historical cargo fmt failure and skipped Rust tests remain historical.

---

현재 게시 범위 (2026-10-16): 실제 데이터 → 검토 → abundance 그림 → 보고서까지 완료된 단위를 게시합니다. GOAL_DONE=false, PAUSED_RESUMABLE입니다.

- SOURCE005: 실제 FLRW Q512/Q1024 z20→4 저장 이력과 기존 그림9개. 기존 검산/PL 비교를 재사용했습니다. 전체 시간·각도 수렴 admission은 HOLD입니다.
- SOURCE009: SIGNED_MINUS/COLD_FLRW z20→19.8 실제 이력42,861states와 앞선 abundance 그림4개.
- SOURCE010: 같은 source/ELF/물리에서 target1e-5→5e-6, NCP 두case 정상완료79,206states. 21관측량 저장PL 비교와 독립 검토 scoped PASS. Tgas 최대 차이약0.00023K는 target+LOCAL/NCP환경 민감도이며 오차상한/차수/독점원인 판정이 아닙니다.
- 최신 SOURCE010 abundance 그림4개: 모든79,206states, nativeYbaryon/전자 분리, elapsed proper time와 chronological actualTgas, zero masking. 실제plot1회7.05s/exit0, 네PNG 직접 시각검토PASS입니다.
- SOURCE011: 외부에서 검토된 residual/Jacobian 모듈을 native accepted-state 관측에 연결했습니다. 마지막24단계1회, 새RHS504native+288observer=792, 측정끝점6185항목 bit-identical. 최종세chemicalstage 국소EOS교정만 보고하며 전체오차/기존민감도 원인을 인증하지 않습니다. 한 번의호출별RHS한도수정과 초기HOLD를 보존했고, 총4개test/build명령30.31s를 모두계상했습니다.
- 로컬Dropbox 먼저조사 후 BASS/REC/BASS_HE/bass_cr/REI새PR을 exactSHA로 조사·반영했습니다. C9진단은 실제코드에 연결했고 PR166동일pre-observer driver/PreparedAbsorption 소유권seam은 supplier범위로등록했습니다. REC99nullboundary, source-matchedreference/age-refinementHOLD, CR76photo-onlyscope를 유지했습니다. 기존22caseBASS자료와 atomicR9부분결과는 구분·중복계상하지 않았습니다.
- SOURCE010fullraw/SOURCE011source+ELF+inputs+outputs/최신그림은 각각Dropboxcreate-only backup및실제remoteSHAreadback을통과했습니다. 비공개원시payload/targetcache는공개git에추가하지않았습니다.

주요 결과·그림·보고서·정확한결손·backup/commit:

전체signedBianchiEoR, isotope-native반응망, 시간·각도·에너지수렴, dynamicEinstein coupling,64core scaling은미완료/HOLD입니다. unknown/tail/absolute-IVPnull을유지합니다. 기존cargo fmt실패와Rustskipped를greenCI로보고하지않습니다. 이PR은draft입니다.
